name: Calviks AB (publ)
summary: Calviks AB (publ), a company established in 2015 and headquartered in Sundbyberg, Sweden, offers specialized recruitment and temporary staffing services across Sweden and the broader Nordic region. They primarily focus on filling pivotal leadership and key roles within both public and private sector organizations. The company's expertise extends to specific fields such as IT, technology, finance, and human resources, and they also provide training initiatives. Currently operating under its new name, Calviks AB (publ), the firm was previously known as Job Solution Sweden Holding AB (publ) and is set to formally complete its name change in June 2025.
